transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this planning meeting started. We've got a backlog of coated brackets and the paint booth is available this weekend. I'm prepared to authorize a weekend campaign, but per policy I need maintenance and environmental compliance sign-off on the operating plan before the first shift begins. I also see we have two certified coating operators available on the roster. So let's hear it -- maintenance, what are your current inspection findings? And environmental compliance, what's your review showing? Once I have both of your formal issues on the table, I'll settle the operating plan.

transcript.text: I need to flag a maintenance issue before we go any further. My inspection this morning measured the booth exhaust filter differential pressure at 2.4 kPa, which is above the 1.5 kPa maintenance limit. The replacement filter is in stores and takes exactly 4 hours to install. I haven't entered the reading in the maintenance system yet, but I'm putting it on the table now -- we'll need to get that filter replaced before the booth can run this weekend.

I see on the roster that two certified operators are available, so that condition can be satisfied. However, the VOC capture test has not yet been conducted, and the updated permit note has not yet been attached to the campaign file. This needs to be addressed before I can sign off on the operating plan.
